statement_en: Let $\alpha>0$ be an irrational number. Is the set\[A=\left\{ n\geq 1: \| \alpha n^2\| < \frac{1}{\log n}\right\},\]where $\|\cdot\|$ denotes the distance to the nearest integer, an additive basis of order $2$?

noncomputable def distToNearestInt (x : ℝ) : ℝ := |x - round x|

open Filter MeasureTheory

def recurrenceSet (α : ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ) : Set ℕ :=
  {n | 1 ≤ n ∧ distToNearestInt (α * n ^ 2) < ε n}

theorem erdos_48907 :
    ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → Irrational α →
    (recurrenceSet α fun n ↦ 1 / Real.log n).IsAsymptoticAddBasisOfOrder 2 := by
  sorry
